content: GOAL: orient before proposing a metric. READ: working directory listing and any available docs/data. OBSERVED: (pending). OPEN: what files exist (SID tables, frozen reference, training split).

GOAL: settle on one in-scope hyperbolic metric distinct from the 97-pair results already listed.
READ: task brief only (no filesystem access: read = permission denied, so all evidence is the supplied measurement table).
OBSERVED: (i) partition-geometry metrics all fail (voronoi margin -0.081, adj R2 +0.156, cover radius -0.122/-0.146); (ii) reference-as-contrast metrics work (HBAA +0.70, cell expected rank +0.582); (iii) plain path likelihood anti-correlates with recall because it rewards collapse, so any rank/likelihood must have an exact 0 at the one-code table and at a random relabelling; (iv) HBAA uses the SOURCE head only and reduces the negatives to a mean; (v) the reference exports BOTH source and target heads per item.
REASONING: the unexploited axes are (a) the TARGET head as the codebook side (the side Stage 3 must actually hit), (b) the FULL negative distribution rather than a mean of ten, (c) the FULL training history as one barycentric query. Build a cross-view Gromov-product AUC: q_i = Lorentz barycentre (K=-1) of source reps of i's full training history; c_h = Lorentz barycentre of target reps in level-1 cell h; score the true cell against every other cell size-weighted, credit same-cell ties 1/2, and normalise by N-1. This is exchangeable under random relabelling so the null is exactly 0 and the one-code table is exactly 0.
OPEN: none; final answer below.

FINAL ANSWER (condensed; full text printed in the response).
METRIC: hyp_xview_gromov_auc
FORMULA: K=-1 Poincare ball. d(x,y)=arcosh(1+2||x-y||^2/((1-||x||^2)(1-||y||^2))); Gromov (x|y)_o=0.5(d(o,x)+d(o,y)-d(x,y)). Lorentz lift X=((1+||x||^2)/(1-||x||^2), 2x/(1-||x||^2)); barycentre of {x_j} = renormalised Lorentz centroid (Frechet at K=-1). q_i = barycentre of source reps s_a over full history H(i)={(a,i) in TRAIN pairs}. h(v)=level-1 SID code, C_h={v:h(v)=h}, n_h=|C_h|, c_h=barycentre of target reps t_v in C_h, A_i(h)=(q_i|c_h)_o. E_i=(1/(N-1))[(n_{h(i)}-1)/2 + sum_{h!=h(i)} n_h*1{A_i(h)<A_i(h(i))}]. HG=mean_{i in I}(E_i-1/2), I={i:|H(i)|>=1}. Range [-1/2,1/2], higher better.
INPUTS: level-1 SID codes; frozen Issue #126 source/target reference arrays s_v,t_v; TRAIN split only.
GEOMETRY: K=-1 enters via (a) Poincare distance making (x|y)_o a common-ancestor depth in the reference's tree-like hierarchy, (b) geodesic Lorentz/Frechet barycentres for q_i and c_h, (c) tangent-space comparison only defined after the exp/lift into the same negative-curvature ball.
WHY TRACK RECALL: Stage 3 hits i if the query emits i's first code above the competing codes. q_i uses the WHOLE training history (not an anchor / mean-of-ten), c_h uses the TARGET head (the retrieval side), and the statistic is against the FULL size-weighted negative code distribution. Adds over Q_H: asks whether the code is the one the query predicts, not whether the prefix is tidy. Adds over HBAA: replaces the single signed margin against a mean-of-ten negatives with a rank/AUC over the full negative distribution, on the target head, invariant to Gromov scale/offset and ungameable by a few easy negatives. Exact degeneracy: one-code table E_i=1/2 -> HG=0; random relabelling exchangeable -> HG~0.
COMPUTE: O(N*d) lifts/barycentres + |I|*K1<=24587*256 Gromov products (~1.6e9 flops), vectorised, seconds; well under a minute; O(N*d) memory.
RISKS: Gromov radial depth bias; heads must share one B^d_{-1} ball else cross-view is noise; sparse TRAIN -> small |I|; arcosh overflow near boundary (clamp 1-1e-6); tiny K1 -> coarse AUC near 0.
FAILURE MODE: adversarial anti-alignment (assign each i the cell with SMALLEST A_i(h)) gives ~-(1/2)(N-K1)/(N-1), the minimum; one-code table gives HG=0 exactly and random relabelling ~0, so collapse/noise is never rewarded; near 0 if target head is uninformative vs source.
END METRIC
